reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20 agent-R: original question asked for a count of standardized lot types and lowest TOSL, which is a Rule III Sec. 703 / Table III topic, off-scope for a Group A dwellings article (Rule VII Sec. 708 + Rule VIII Sec. 805-811). Replaced with a Sec. 808 window-opening-destination question directly supported by the article.

checked_sources.label: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR (DPWH Official)
checked_sources.section_locator: Rule VIII / Section 808 Sizes of Window Openings

source_audit_support.citation: PD 1096 2004 Revised IRR, Rule VIII, Section 808

proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VIII Section 808, the required window opening of a habitable room in a Group A dwelling must open directly onto which of the following in order to be counted toward the minimum ventilation area?

options.text: A court, yard, public space, or air shaft that has direct access to outer air
A covered carport or garage, provided the opening is at least 1.00 sq.m
An adjacent enclosed room that has its own window, regardless of where that window opens
A roofed-over balcony or lanai of any size, regardless of whether it connects to outer air

proposed.rationale: Section 808 requires the required window opening to face directly onto a court, yard, public space, or air shaft with direct access to outer air. A window facing a covered or enclosed space (carport, adjacent enclosed room, roofed lanai without outer-air connection) cannot be counted toward the Section 808 minimum.
proposed.explanation: The destination of the opening matters: the 10 percent / 1.00 sq.m minimum is only credited when the window actually breathes into a genuine outside air volume, not into another covered space.
